title: Disable the controlled HTTP 500 mode
likely_root_cause: The application is deliberately returning HTTP 500 responses while its service and database remain healthy.
recovery_steps: Call the allow-listed internal fault endpoint with enabled=false.
Do not change application files or execute arbitrary commands.
verification_steps: Confirm the HTTP 500 fault status is disabled.
Confirm service liveness and database health return HTTP 200.
rollback_note: If the controlled flag cannot be disabled, stop and escalate without changing unrelated settings.
